findings.title: Bundled unrelated changes in the same working tree
findings.detail: pom.xml (spring-boot-flyway), RestClientConfig.java (SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory multipart fix), DocumentService.java (saveAndFlush/flush FK ordering), PromptBuilder.java (prompt-injection hardening), and RestDocServiceClient.java (richer error logging) are modified alongside the real-embedding files. These are separate bug-fixes for the user's earlier upload/boot errors, not the real-embedding task; PromptBuilder is nominally the chat path the plan said to leave unchanged. Not introduced by the embedding files and not blocking; should be committed/reviewed under their own task.

findings.title: Verification evidence not persisted in task dir
findings.detail: The real-embedding task directory contains only plan.md; no file records the required `python -m pytest -q` and `mvnw.cmd -q test` results. Python behavior was independently re-verified live in the service .venv (lazy import, real-provider selection, 384-dim normalized vectors, semantic ordering). The Java `mvnw.cmd -q test` result remains unverified by the reviewer. Record commands + results in the final report.

findings.title: Uncaught real-model load failure in /v1/embed route
findings.detail: get_embedding_provider() selects the real provider via find_spec without loading; if the model then fails to load on the FIRST embed() call (offline/disk), _ModelUnavailable propagates out of provider.embed() and the route (app/api.py) has no try/except around it, surfacing as a 500 instead of degrading to the stub. The import-absent path is handled correctly (factory -> stub). Minor, real-path only.
